name: design-research
summary: Research and narrow a visual direction through an evidence-backed moodboard, annotated references, anti-SaaS checks, and explicit alternatives before design implementation.
inputs: brief, audience, business goal, primary user task, and funnel when known
approved Brand, Voice, Design Tokens, content, proof, assets, and Stack context when available
writes: approved project research packet or moodboard destination
optional reviewed reference records when explicitly requested
external_reads: selected inspiration, template, CRO, typography, and implementation resources
existing rendered/source evidence for redesign research when in scope
approval_gates: do not treat reference screenshots, copied assets, or external style systems as production authority
do not advance to implementation until the research packet and selected direction are approved
done_when: brief, authority, gaps, page/job, and research scope are explicit
selected references are relevant, contrasting, provenance-labeled, and annotated
moodboard/reference packet records what to borrow and what not to copy
anti-SaaS checks and accessibility/mobile implications are evaluated
two or three materially different directions and decision criteria are returned
approval state and next design-delivery handoff are explicit
verification: verify source URLs and retrieval status for external references
verify reference cards distinguish authority, current-system-fact, observation, proposal, and gap
verify no production assets, copied claims, screenshots, logos, fonts, or code are implied without rights
verify research packet path and changed Markdown/frontmatter when written
parent session independently verifies the packet before routing to implementation
